Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
457 AM EDT Fri Oct 2 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM EDT THIS MORNING...
...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM LATE TONIGHT THROUGH SATURDAY
MORNING...

.REST OF THE OVERNIGHT...SW winds 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves
2 ft. 
.TODAY...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt early in the
morning. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.TONIGHT...SW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming NW late in the evening,
then becoming N 15 to 20 kt after midnight. Waves 1 to 2 ft. Showers
likely. 
.SAT...N winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. A chance
of showers. 
.SAT NIGHT...NE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. A chance of showers. 
.SUN...NE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. Showers.
.SUN NIGHT...N winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft...building to 3 ft
after midnight. 
.TUE...N winds 15 to 20 kt...diminishing to 5 to 10 kt. Waves 2 ft...
subsiding to flat.
